SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM 
    superhero s
JOIN 
    gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
